name: Interlock/InTr Governed Transition
purpose: Evaluate and apply one already-admitted state-transition request through the applicable Interlock/InTr transition authority, preserving the distinction between internal inference, action admission, consequence, standing, and authority effect.
trigger: an admitted operation proposes a state transition or externally consequential action
scope: one proposed transition on one resolved InTr protocol
reuse_instructions: Use the applicable existing InTr evaluator/transition surface. Do not collapse inference into governance and do not treat successful execution, capability realization, transport success, or provider response as automatic authority or standing.
